verdict.rationale: A registered-agent and business-compliance service could plausibly offer a public API, so this axis applies. The evidence describes only a web dashboard, email and postcard notifications, and staff-managed paperwork, with no documented public API for reading or managing entity records or registered-agent appointments. The llms.txt probe is guidance for AI crawlers, not a developer API.

support.subject: As a developer, I can read or manage entity records and registered-agent appointments programmatically through a documented public API
